text.en: This Act may be cited as the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank Act.

In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires — “Agreement” means the Agreement for the establishment and operation of the international body known as the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank done at Beijing on 29th June 2015 and entered into force on 25th December 2015; “Article” means an Article of the Agreement; “Bank” means the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank established under the Agreement; “Minister” means the Minister of Finance and Economy.

The Minister, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, may empower a person named in an instrument under the Minister’s hand to deposit, on behalf of the Government of Brunei Darussalam, an instrument of ratification of the Agreement with the Government of the People’s Republic of China stating that the Government of Brunei Darussalam —

(a) has accepted the Agreement in accordance with the written laws of Brunei Darussalam; and

(b) has taken all steps necessary to enable the Government of Brunei Darussalam to carry out all its obligations under the

heading.en: Power to subscribe to shares of Bank
Sums payable to Bank to be charged on Consolidated Fund

text.en: The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, create and issue to the Bank, in such form as he thinks fit, any such non-negotiable and non-interest-bearing notes or other obligations as are provided for by paragraph 6 of Article 6.

heading.en: Moneys received by Government to be paid into Consolidated Fund

text.en: All sums received by or on behalf of the Government from the Bank are to be paid into the Consolidated Fund.

heading.en: Certain provisions of Agreement to have force of law

text.en:
(1) Despite anything to the contrary in any other law, the provisions of the Agreement set out in the Schedule have the force of law.

(2) Nothing in Article 51 is to be construed as —

(a) entitling the Bank to import into Brunei Darussalam goods free of any customs duty without any restriction on their subsequent sale in Brunei Darussalam;

(b) conferring on the Bank any exemption from taxes or duties which form part of the price of goods sold or services supplied; or

(c) conferring on the Bank any exemption from taxes or duties which are in fact no more than charges for services rendered.

(3) The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, by notification published in the Gazette, amend the Schedule in conformity with any amendments to the provisions of the Agreement set out in the Schedule which may be subsequently made and adopted. Bank of shares, debentures etc.

heading.en: Companies Act (Chapter 39) does not apply to Bank and to issue by

text.en: The Bank is not to be treated as a company within the meaning of the Companies Act (Chapter 39) and the provisions of that Act do not accordingly apply to the Bank or to the issue by the Bank of any shares, debentures, bonds, notes or other securities. Power to make regulations

(1) The Minister may, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, make regulations which are necessary or expedient for giving effect to and carrying out the provisions of this Act and for the due administration thereof.

(2) Such regulations may include such incidental, consequential and supplementary provisions as the Minister considers necessary or expedient. (section 8)
